title: Font register reconciliation — one brand register, default == rendered
status: GREEN (device-free arms; π-lane live arm authored fail-closed, orchestrator runs on Metal device)
summary: The library DEFAULT font register now equals the register the demo and consumers actually paint: Plus Jakarta Sans (text/display) + Fira Code (mono), with NO preset opt-out, NO inert face, and NO body-defaults-to-a-display-serif. The `--font-stack-display`/`--font-stack-serif` tokens, the body cascade, and the heading/body/display utility ladder were re-grounded onto the brand register; the brand-uniform-sans escape-hatch preset + the demo `--font-brand-sans`/`data-typography-preset` indirection were collapsed; a distinct system-serif `--font-serif` register was kept for the `.cm-serif`/`text-math` math voice; and the docs were rewritten to the actual register.
baseline_note: This worktree base (a09c2b6) PRE-DATES the AX charter audit baseline (eaba94f). The font surface was in a cleaner-but-broken form: `src/fonts/fraunces/` + the Fraunces `@font-face` + `proof:font-axes` + `proof:font-canon` were ALREADY ABSENT in this base, while `tokens.css` still pointed `--font-stack-display` at "Fraunces" and `--font-stack-serif` at "Computer Modern Serif" (both non-shipped → paint inert to Georgia), and the demo forced Plus Jakarta via the triple-indirection `data-typography-preset` preset. The gestalt fix path (a) EXCISE applies to what EXISTS; the woff2/fonts.css-block/proof:font-axes deletions noted in the charter were no-ops here (already gone).

fold0_adjudication.rationale: The AC.W6b brand register (Plus Jakarta Sans + Fira Code, with the Capsize-calibrated Plus Jakarta Sans Fallback) predates Fraunces by an entire arc and IS what the demo + speedtest render. The AU.W4 Fraunces ship was a `[slipped]`-tagged mechanical token-fix to make a dangling display token non-inert, never wired into the consumer register. In THIS base the Fraunces face never even materialized (no woff2, no @font-face), so it was substrate-with-zero-consumer and zero-renderer — the textbook excise case. value.js self-supplies Fraunces from its own @theme + Google-Fonts (constellation result[10]), proving the library need not ship it (presets-in-consumers).
fold0_adjudication.AS_P5: KILLED — the self-hosted full-axes Fraunces @font-face does NOT ship. The WONK/SOFT editorial voice lives in the consumers that want it.

RW1_default_not_rendered.claim: The library DEFAULT body/display register named a face NO live surface renders.
RW1_default_not_rendered.evidence_pre: tokens.css `--font-stack-display: "Fraunces", Georgia, serif` + `--font-stack-serif: "Computer Modern Serif", "Latin Modern Roman", "CMU Serif", Georgia, serif`; theme.css bridged them to --font-display/--font-serif; typography.css `body { font-family: var(--font-serif) }`. By library default all body/heading/prose/display text resolved to a non-shipped serif → Georgia. The demo forced Plus Jakarta via `index.html` `data-typography-preset="brand-uniform-sans"` + demo.css `--font-brand-sans`.
RW1_default_not_rendered.born_red: 8 detector violations on the pre-wave default (body reads --font-serif; --font-stack-text undeclared; --font-stack-display leads with Fraunces; off-canon Fraunces + Computer Modern Serif + Latin Modern Roman; data-typography-preset opt-out in typography.css AND index.html).
RW1_default_not_rendered.green_after: body reads --font-text; --font-stack-text + --font-stack-display lead with the shipped "Plus Jakarta Sans"; zero data-typography-preset; the math --font-serif is Georgia/Times (distinct, paintable).

RW2_substrate_without_consumer.claim: A green static gate institutionalized a ~40KB face for ZERO live renderers.
RW2_substrate_without_consumer.evidence_in_this_base: MOOT in this base — `src/fonts/fraunces/`, the Fraunces `@font-face`, and `proof:font-axes` were ALREADY ABSENT at a09c2b6. The institutionalized-dead-substrate defect had not yet been minted here; the residual was only the token-level pointer at the (non-existent) face. The excise is enforced going-forward by `proof:font-cascade`'s OFF_CANON_DEFAULT guard (re-adding Fraunces to a --font-stack-* → RED).
RW2_substrate_without_consumer.green_after: no Fraunces in any --font-stack-*; the gate REDs if any is re-added.

RW3_static_gates_blind.claim: No gate at HEAD loaded the live demo, awaited document.fonts.ready, and asserted which face PAINTS.
RW3_static_gates_blind.green_after: `proof:font-cascade` ships a device-free SOURCE/STRUCTURE arm (hard-REDs on every runner) + a fail-CLOSED π-lane live arm (`tests-visual/font-cascade.spec.ts`: live getComputedStyle + document.fonts.ready + canvas glyph-width fingerprint, the DOM-cascade readback per result[30].findings[7]). The orchestrator runs the live arm on the Metal device.

findings_disposition.F0_three_incompatible_intents: RESOLVED — one register model, one source. `--font-stack-text`/`--font-stack-display` = Plus Jakarta; `--font-stack-serif` = a distinct system serif math voice; `--font-stack-sans`/`--font-stack-mono` unchanged. theme.css bridges; typography.css consumes — no third declaration site.
findings_disposition.F1_fraunces_substrate: RESOLVED via path (a) — zero Fraunces across src/styles + demo + package.json + scripts (deletion-proof GREEN). The dir/@font-face/proof:font-axes were already absent in this base.
findings_disposition.F2_static_gates_blind: RESOLVED — `proof:font-cascade` runtime-observation gate replaces the static-only blindness. The necessary-only canon pre-check (every named face resolves to a shipped @font-face or a generic/system keyword) is folded into the source arm.
findings_disposition.F3_preset_undoes_default: RESOLVED — the `:root[data-typography-preset="brand-uniform-sans"]` block + `--font-brand-sans` indirection deleted; index.html preset attr + demo.css override deleted. The demo renders the real default with zero override.
